P1.1.text: Florida Commercial Residential Property Insurance | American Coastal Insurance

P1.2.text: American Coastal Insurance Company writes commercial residential property in Florida. Condo, HOA, apartment, and assisted living through AmRisc Group and Skyway Underwriters.

P1.3.text: American Coastal Insurance Company · Florida specialty

P1.4.text: Florida’s largest voluntary writer of commercial residential property.

P1.5.text: Writing commercial property in FL. Condo, HOA, apartment and assisted living properties.

P1.6.text: The admitted solution for catastrophe-exposed commercial property in Florida.

P1.8.text: Find your binding path. Retail agents and brokers place condo and HOA through AmRisc. Wholesale brokers place apartment and assisted living through Skyway.

P1.9.text: Start with the product line. Garden-style condos and HOAs flow through AmRisc.

P1.10.text: File through AmRisc for condo or HOA, Skyway for apartment and assisted living.

P1.11.text: Nearly two decades of Florida commercial residential underwriting.

P1.12.text: Based in Saint Petersburg, FL, writing through every Florida storm season since. The largest voluntary writer of commercial residential property in the state, with a catastrophe tower rebuilt every season.

P1.13.text: FL voluntary writer of commercial residential

P1.14.text: Condo, HOA, apartment, and assisted living.

P1.15.text: Garden-style FL condos and homeowner associations.

P1.16.text: Garden-style risks built to current Florida wind standards. ISO Special Perils, Ordinance or Law, mitigation credits. The core of the Florida condo and HOA book.

P1.17.text: Submissions route through AmRisc Group. Florida condo and HOA insurance

P1.18.text: Florida apartment communities, written through Skyway.

P1.19.text: Risk-scored intake, inspection-driven pricing, deductible flexibility. Building, contents, business income, sinkhole, wind-driven precipitation.

P1.20.text: Submissions route through Skyway Underwriters. Florida apartment insurance

P1.21.text: Florida assisted and independent living facilities, written through Skyway.

P1.22.text: Property-only coverage. ResiQuant-enabled intake with engineering-grade wind underwriting. Targeting risks with characteristics consistent with our apartment book.

P1.23.text: Submissions route through Skyway Underwriters. Florida assisted living insurance

P1.24.text: In Florida, the reinsurance tower is the policy.

P1.25.text: When a named storm lands, the structure behind the policy pays the claim. We rebuild that catastrophe tower every June 1, layering our own retention, the Florida Hurricane Catastrophe Fund, a panel of highly rated and collateralized reinsurers, and catastrophe bonds in the capital markets.

P1.26.text: Carrier retention at the base, the in the middle, and a panel of traditional reinsurers above it, with catastrophe bonds layered throughout. Every program is built to exceed the Florida statutory minimum.

P1.27.text: The traditional layers are placed with reinsurers rated A− or better by AM Best, or fully collateralized. A broad panel keeps concentration with any single counterparty low.

P1.28.text: Participating in the state catastrophe fund lowers our cost of capital against the surplus-lines market, and that edge flows through to how we price the risk.

P1.29.text: The catastrophe tower is rebuilt every June 1. Financial strength rated A (Exceptional) by Demotech and A (Stable) by KBRA. Current program detail is filed with the SEC and posted at investors.amcoastal.com (opens in new tab).

P1.30.text: How the catastrophe tower is built

P1.31.text: We don’t sell direct. Two MGAs feed every submission.

P1.32.text: Exclusive MGA for our condominium and HOA business.

P1.33.text: One of the largest MGAs in the country, specializing in hurricane-exposed properties.

P1.34.text: Exclusive MGA for our apartment and assisted living business.

P1.35.text: An MGA focused on catastrophe-exposed risk, running a proprietary risk-scored underwriting portal.

P1.36.text: WSIA member. American Coastal Insurance Company is a member of the Wholesale & Specialty Insurance Association (opens in new tab), the trade body for the wholesale, specialty, and surplus lines market. The membership reflects how we distribute: AmRisc, Skyway, and the E&S program underway through Skyway all place business in that market.

P1.37.text: The team that runs the carrier.

P1.38.text: Owns underwriting strategy, risk selection, and portfolio performance across the book.

P1.39.text: Leads finance, treasury, reinsurance, and the rating-agency relationships.

P1.40.text: Oversees compliance, enterprise risk, and internal audit, and serves on the carrier board.

P1.3.text: Kingstone Companies, Inc. (“Kingstone”) is a northeast regional property and casualty insurance holding company whose principal operating subsidiary is Kingstone Insurance Company (“KICO”). KICO is a New York domiciled carrier writing business through retail and wholesale agents and brokers. KICO is actively writing personal lines and commercial auto insurance in New York, and was the 11th largest writer of homeowners insurance in the State of New York. Kingstone is also licensed in New Jersey, Rhode Island, Massachusetts, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, New Hampshire, and Maine.
